messages:
Maya: Heads up — after deploy of PR #4598 we see a clear latency regression for streaming endpoints, median +260ms, p95 +1.1s. Rolling back now?
perf-bot: perf-ci/streaming: FAILED — baseline median=180ms, current median=440ms (+144%), p95 +1.1s (regression detected).
Lucas: I started a local bisect. Reverting 4598 locally brings medians back to baseline. Suspect SSE framing/buffering change in that PR.
Ben: Confirming — PR 4598 changed SSE flush semantics and also added synchronous JSON.stringify in tool-call path (to unify record format).
Olivia: Flamegraph from a repro run shows big hot path: writev -> sse_flush -> stringify -> serializeToolOutput -> sys_write. First-byte delayed while full serialization completes.
Lucas: KV cache metrics look stable (hit rate ~87%), so not a cache capacity issue. Thread profile shows more time in batching queue and a couple of locks around the stream serializer.
Maya: CI perf job reproduces only for streaming+tool-calls combined. Pure generation endpoints are fine. That pattern matches the stringify hypothesis.
Ben: Quick local patch: reverted synchronous stringify and offloaded to background task — median latency drops back. Pushed a formal revert PR (4602).
ci-bot: Deploy started for canary infra-canary-02 (PR 4602).
perf-bot: Canary perf check queued — running streaming latency suite.
perf-bot: Canary results: median=195ms, p95 within baseline. Canary confirms rollback fixes the regression.
Olivia: Root cause summary: the new coalescing buffer intended to reduce small writes coalesced SSE frames but called JSON.stringify synchronously for tool responses. Large tool payloads blocked the write path until serialization finished, amplifying first-byte latency.
Maya: Action items: (1) ship revert #4602 to unblock rollout, (2) implement async serialization/streaming patch (Ben/Olivia) so we can reintroduce coalescing without blocking, (3) add microbench CI that includes large tool payload serialization and first-byte latency assertions.
Ben: Proposed async fix snippet:
```js
// offload heavy stringify to microtask/worker
queueMicrotask(() => sink.write(JSON.stringify(toolResp)))
```
Ben: Also noted a separate kernel-selection churn in one worker (fused-attn path chosen after a heuristic tweak) — appears unrelated but I'll open a follow-up since it altered latency variance.
Lucas: I'm preparing release notes and a blameless postmortem; will include perf diffs and bisect steps.
Olivia: I'll own the async serialize patch + CI test. Expect WIP PR later today.
Maya: Good. Let's keep the rollback on the fast-track and add a perf-gate that fails PRs which increase median streaming first-byte by >50ms. :thumbsup:
Lucas: Adding that perf gate to CI template now.
Maya: Thanks — closing the immediate rollout blocker once 4602 is merged and canaryed.
